dct_description_sm:
Replication Data and Code for: Impact of switching from a quadrivalent to a nonavalent HPV vaccine on HPV infections and cervical cancer in Colombia: a mathematical modeling study. 
This dataset contains the model-generated arrays of carcinogenic HPV prevalence and incidence for Colombia under multiple vaccination scenarios, along with the R scripts used to produce these arrays.
